newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuban killed in house collapse.
newsitem.headline: Cuban killed in house collapse.

text.p: A woman was killed and two men were injured on Tuesday when part of a building in central Havana collapsed following several days of rain, officials said.

The state news agency AIN said residents had been evacuated from the building two weeks ago because it was in a poor state of repair and was in danger of collapsing. Part of a wall crumbled on Tuesday, falling onto the pavement and killing a woman passer-by. Two people in a passing police car were injured.
House collapses have become a regular feature in the older parts of Havana, especially during periods of heavy rain.

City officials said last year that there were some 614 house collapses in 1994. Out of Havana's total of about 550,000 homes, nearly half were in a regular or poor state and several thousand were in a "critical state," the authorities said.
